summary: Enforce terminal cleanup of local workspaces and remote branches without destroying unique data

delivery.outcome: A completed task leaves no disposable local workspace and no orphan remote branch while preserving every unmerged or unclassified datum
nonGoals: No automatic deletion by CI or the checker
No claim that GitHub Actions can inspect a developer filesystem
No publication of the combined standard candidate

architecture.decision: Use separate deterministic local and GitHub lifecycle checks, package both enforcement surfaces, and keep deletion behind explicit verified cleanup
interfaceChanges: Adopted package gains a local workspace checker and managed remote lifecycle workflow
architecture.rollback: Revert before candidate publication; existing remote-only written policy remains

validation.evidence: Fixtures distinguish primary, linked worktree, duplicate clone, allowlisted active workspace and clean resting state
Package installs both checkers and managed target workflow with live GitHub snapshot acquisition

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
validation.evidence: Contract stays green and all remaining workspace exceptions are classified
